overview: The Medford City Council approved a grant of location for Eversource's underground transmission line project, voted to issue a cease-and-desist order for an industrial zoning violation on Alfred Street, and authorized $268,000 for emergency water main repairs on Douglas Road. The Council also received an update on the Community Preservation Act application process and passed several local resolutions.

items.title: Grant of Location for Eversource Transmission Line Project (Paper 17-734)
items.summary: Approved the grant of location for Eversource's underground transmission line project following discussion of neighborhood notifications, water infrastructure safeguards, and planned raised crosswalks.

items.title: Special Permit Review for Wegmans Extended Hours (Paper 17-590)
items.summary: Approved scheduling the next review in 60 days for the extended hours special permit at Wegmans after officials reported no complaints.

items.title: Public Comment on Green Line Extension Notification
items.summary: A resident requested a reverse 911 notification to inform residents of the extended public comment deadline for the Green Line Extension project.

items.title: Cease-and-Desist Order Request for 9 Alfred Street
items.summary: Approved a motion directing the building commissioner to issue an immediate cease-and-desist order to J.F. White for non-compliant industrial construction operations and noise in a residential area.

items.title: Removal of Double Utility Poles (Paper 17-785)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting National Grid to immediately remove double poles on Alexander Avenue and Barnard Road.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Funding Process Update (Paper 17-786)
items.summary: Received and placed on file an update from the Community Preservation Committee regarding the completion of the local preservation plan and the initial grant application deadlines.

items.title: Appropriation for Douglas Road Water Main Repair (Paper 17-787)
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $268,000 from retained earnings to replace an aging water main and perform curb-to-curb repaving on Douglas Road following a severe leak.

items.title: Condolence Resolution for Marguerite Regan
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing condolences to the family of retired teacher Marguerite Regan following a moment of silence.

items.title: Resolution on Shared Bicycle Regulations
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a plan and direct contact information from a dockless bicycle sharing service regarding bikes left in public rights-of-way.

items.title: Resolution on Out-of-State Vehicle Parking Enforcement
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting increased traffic enforcement for out-of-state vehicles parked long-term on Cherry, Tainter, Everett, and Fulton Streets.

items.title: Committee Report on Medford Square Master Plan (Paper 17-788)
items.summary: Approved the Committee of the Whole report from November 28, 2017, regarding the Medford Square Master Plan.
